author: Tpak
body: Well, 2 months ago I got banned for hacking. And, yes, it was on my account, it was my friend Liam who decided to download Huzuni 1.8 and go hacking on avic.us I had tonnes of servers and he picked a random one and unfortunately for me, it was Avicus. I am making this appeal now because I did noticed I had got banned, but I decided to wait for a bit to make sure that you will believe me. Hopefully you read this post. Thank you for reading -BillyyR
